source.book: Mitchell, The New "Standard" Work on Designing and Pattern-Making of Ladies' Tailor-Made Garments (1921)
source.table: Skirt Foundation, pp. 84–85; Five Gored Skirt, pp. 90–91

rights: Published 1921 (Mitchell Publications, New York), public domain in the US. Drafting methods are uncopyrightable (project policy). Points are constructed from the text's rules by ccat; curves the text leaves "as per diagram" and the lapel are traced from the book's diagrams and set onto the constructed points (tracing pattern geometry is fair use, project policy).

status.construction: numbered-point draft, curves traced from the diagram
status.note: Five-gored skirt: front panel (centre front on the fold), side gores and back gores (centre back seam), darts at the panel and side lines and the centre back, floor length (front 38, back 39½). Not test-sewn. The side dart takes the draft's own surplus (2.35 in; the book's "2½ in this case" is a report).

export.seam_allowance_basis: export default, uniform; not from the source
export.darts: cut edge runs straight across the dart mouth (caps not trued); drill hole 1 cm short of the apex
